arguments.description: One static 16 by 16 pixel-art UI status icon communicating successful completion (Ready), shared by full and compact queue cells. Propose a simple clear checkmark silhouette as the first representative sample, not an already approved style. Transparent background. Use the existing UI cool blue accent; #70b9ed from the preserved Start vector is a color cue, not a mandatory exact palette. No fixed palette. Prioritize readable silhouette and deliberate pixel clusters/edges at native 1x and nearest-neighbor 3x on dark panel #172336. The completion meaning should read clearly rather than activity, failure/retry or pause; later family comparison will confirm distinctions when those assets exist. Single standalone icon, one frame, for assets/ready.png; do not draw the panel, label, Start control, activity loop, retry or paused assets. No approved style image exists; this is a direction proposal for review.

value.intent: One static transparent Ready completion icon for assets/ready.png shared by statusCell and compactStatus; checkmark is an expert sample proposal; no approved style yet.

intake.rationale: Concrete candidate interpretation for the reviewed scope; source requirements retain their original authority in the selected PLAR and packet.

requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decode the eventual candidate as a single static 16x16 PNG image, one frame.

requirements.name: transparency
requirements.check: Confirm transparent background with no opaque matte; full alpha is allowed and no binary-alpha restriction applies.

requirements.name: meaning
requirements.check: At 1x and 3x the Ready candidate communicates successful completion rather than ongoing activity, failure/retry or pause. Assess its own meaning now; do not require unproduced family members.

requirements.name: readability
requirements.check: Inspect actual candidate at native 1x and 3x nearest display scale on #172336; silhouette remains legible and deliberate pixel clusters/edges support the icon at both scales.

requirements.name: cool_blue
requirements.check: Candidate uses the existing cool blue UI accent direction coherently with the preserved Start control; do not reject solely for differing exact colors or palette count.
